title: inga biglobosa
intro: Inga biglobosa, commonly known as the African walnut or big-leaf inga, is a tropical tree species native to West and Central Africa. The tree has been found to have various health benefits, including the potential to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and improve cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Inga biglobosa include its ability to act as an anti-diarrheal, antispasmodic, and antimalarial agent, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Inga biglobosa include flavonoids, tannins, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
